privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads or automatic storage.
drop: Drop a text or log file here
encodingError: This file cannot be decoded with the selected encoding. Choose another encoding to read it without replacing unreadable characters.
binary: The decoded file contains NUL characters and may be binary. Check the encoding or choose a plain-text file.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while reading this file. Close other tabs and try again.
readError: This file could not be read. Choose it again or open another file.
findHelp: Case-sensitive literal search across the entire file. Enter finds the next match; Shift+Enter finds the previous match.
scope: The file is shown in sections. Selection and browser Find apply to the current section. Use Find text to search the entire file. Long lines continue in adjacent sections.
literal: Markup and terminal commands remain text. Control characters are not interpreted and may have no visible glyph. Line endings are displayed as line breaks.
